reason: The cited evidence (E1) supports that magnetic field treatment can simultaneously improve strength and plasticity in QAl9-4 aluminum bronze via dislocation rearrangement and grain refinement, but it provides no evidence regarding MnNiSi-based alloys, the preservation of magnetocaloric properties, or the specific pulsed-field and annealing conditions proposed. The key premise that the magnetostructural transition is retained is entirely unsupported.
premises: Pulsed magnetic field treatment enhances dislocation mobility and rearrangement in alloys
Enhanced dislocation mobility leads to grain refinement and a more homogeneous microstructure
Grain refinement and uniform dislocation distribution simultaneously improve strength and ductility
Microstructural refinement does not disrupt the magnetostructural transition or magnetocaloric effect
These effects observed in other alloys (e.g., QAl9-4) will transfer to MnNiSi-based alloys
